Spell Check as an Archival Existence Proof [M/S · unmetered]

Traces primary retail ads from USD 200 standalone Commodore PET WordCheck (Compute!, Jan 1981) and USD 89-99 Grammatik to OS-bundled zero-license routines — scoped strictly to bounded local tools.

1/2 Dated retail price ledger [S]:
- HP 9100A USD 4,900 (1968) -> HP-35 USD 395 (1972) / USD 195 (1975)
- WordCheck USD 200 (1981) & Grammatik II/III USD 89-99 -> bundled in WordPerfect 3.0 (1983), MS Word 2.0 (~1985), WP 5.2 (1992) & Hunspell (USD 0 license)

2/2 Narrow scope & reach limits:
- Bundling to zero required near-zero local marginal cost (McIlroy 1982 64 KB dictionary) + editor complementarity — NOT a claim that frontier cloud AI becomes free
- Bundled tools reach ~4.7B-5.5B connected users, not all >7B
- Unmetered
